text.en: This Order may be cited as the Properties, Rights and Liabilities (Exclusion from Transfer) Order. Exclusion of property, rights and liabilities

The property of the Prime Minister Corporation specified in the Schedule and the rights and liabilities with respect thereto is hereby excluded from any transfer under section 7(1) to the Minister for Finance Corporation. 6 CAP. 264, O 1 (Incorporation)

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2) Jerambak Holdings Pty Ltd in Australia.
